title: Speaking Practice 27 - Health and Lifestyle
description: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Discussion questions about health and lifestyle.

stimuli.title: Part 3: Health and Lifestyle Discussion
stimuli.content: In Part 3, the examiner asks abstract questions. Give extended answers with examples.

questionGroups.instruction: Discuss the following questions. Give detailed answers with examples.

questions.content: Why do many people have unhealthy lifestyles?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Busy work schedules, easy access to fast food, and sedentary jobs all contribute. Many people know what is healthy but lack the time or motivation to make changes.
Yes, through public health campaigns, taxing unhealthy products like sugary drinks, and investing in sports facilities and parks.

questions.content: How important is mental health compared to physical health?

explanation.sampleAnswer: They are equally important and deeply interconnected. Poor mental health can lead to physical illness, and vice versa. Unfortunately, mental health still carries stigma in many cultures.

questions.content: What can individuals do to improve their wellbeing?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Regular exercise, adequate sleep, a balanced diet, and maintaining social connections are the foundations. Even small changes like a 30-minute daily walk can make a huge difference.
